The '''''Byblos Journal of Historical Science''''' was a regular publication put out by the History department of the [[University of Byblos/Legends|University of Byblos]].

==History==
In [[104 ABY]], the Journal published the article ''[[Tinker, Tailor, Soldier, Praji]]'', which revolved around the history of the [[House Praji/Legends|Praji family]].
